notes.title: Pet Update Delayed
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.

If you have played the new update, you might notice that there are quite a few problems. We sincerely apologise. We did not see them coming, as there were a bunch of super weird issues that didn't appear during our testing. We will not be able to resolve these issues in the short term, so we have made the difficult decision to delay the update by a week in hopes of getting things stable enough for everyone.

Since we updated the engine from 4 to 5, we are forced to load yesterday's backups as saves are not backwards compatible. We know this is incredibly frustrating, and we're truly sorry for the lost progress. The good thing is that you can still earn and open pet tackle boxes, and you'll be able to equip them in the update when it becomes available.

In the next few hours after this post, I will be reverting the update and closing servers to load the backups. Servers will come online one by one when maintenance is completed.

Thank you for your patience and understanding during this frustrating situation. We're deeply sorry for the inconvenience and the disruption to your gameplay. We'll work around the clock to make sure the next release is much smoother.

New features


Option to toggle Q-hold view change in general settings.
Introduced a prestige system for resetting compendium, money, and progression for additional house slots. Prestige stays with the player on other servers and is not reset when the server is wiped.
Added more paths to upgrading the tent. It can now be upgraded to a shop, mining rig, or water mill that have unique benefits but can be raided, so beware. You are also required to have at least 1 cabin before upgrading to others.
Improved Electrical panel functionality: View all electricity devices and set high priority for devices requiring stable electricity.

Added Roaming NPC that collects items found on the map and trades them for Mk.
House upgrades that don't change the house shape can now be uninstalled, note that resources are not gained back.
Added ammo, sauna, and greenhouse sell limits to general vendors to prevent abuse of item duplication.
Added 4 new quests, introducing players to new elements and challenges in this update.

Battery item in-game now has a charge level that can be charged up in the Battery Charging Station. You can put full batteries in the Battery Backup Station that provides electricity to your house if the power requirements are not met.
New mini turret added that uses batteries to power up when not near any house. This can be destroyed by shooting. If near a house, it uses the house's electricity instead of a battery.

Cooking outfit is now given when the player gets the cooking compendium completed.
Added a treasure map.


Changes


Added new fishing spots around the lighthouse.
Maximum team size capped at 12 players.
Removed cooked trout from the Vendo-O machine in the lighthouse.
Ingots pay out now 2x more.
Increased grenade throwing animations and projectile speeds by approximately 30%.
Turrets have doubled downtime if disabled and reactivated within 30 sec.
Melee damage against players doubled.
Eating the same type of food multiple times now causes you to get less energy from that. However, if the food type is "other," it's excluded from this debuff to encourage cooking more complex recipes.
Score can now be gained from chopping wood, mining rocks, cooking, and selling items to regular non-player placed vendors.
Changed visual style of ping value of server while playing. Also added a server performance indicator.
New swimming and hatchet animations.
Raised Global inventory unlock price since the LRI stations are now more freely available.
Adjusted backpack sizes to be roughly the same size as the starting backpack.


Weapon balance changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655015/ae13c20a88ee4ae776115dc08b6538b20ca1ec55.png


Reduced semi-auto fire rate by 30%.
Reduced sawed-off shotgun projectiles from 9 to 8.

Team scores now persist when switching teams.
Admin panel button hidden for non-admin players.
Chat messages limited to 160 characters.
Getting ping to server caused a lot of lag when the server was highly populated. Made a new method of getting the ping that does not cause lagging.
Fireplace healing is now capped to 4 concurrent to bring maximum healing effect to prevent overhealing.


Monthly scoreboard and new dynamic events

To make playing more fun, we have added a new twist to the score system we built for servers. All your achieved scores will be counted on a global leaderboard where the best players are rewarded with custom hats every month!

We also added a second type of event where you need to do certain actions like fishing, cooking, farming, or mining, etc. Your actions are counted towards the goal, and if you do enough, you earn vintercoins, and the best players are also rewarded with a custom hat with a special effect.

PVE Adjustments


Turrets no longer engage players since they can't do damage.
Plants cannot be picked up.
Chests cannot be opened on other players' yards.
Greenhouse cannot be entered if you don't own it.
Weather station cannot be stolen from.


New Spring Catalog


In-game shop now has updated items and much-requested female outfits to buy and wear.
Added new tackle box to drop table and new key to the shop.

notes.title: 1.11 Halloween update
notes.notes:
Changes

Added 10 new cosmetic items to the game that can be earned by playing the game during the Halloween event. Note that some rewards must be discovered from the game level to unlock them.
Map now has Halloween decorations
Optimized player turrets to not be as CPU intensive on the server side
Mining helmet can now be bought from the vendor in Sgt. Lake base camp
Electric pickaxe can now be found in weapon chests
Trees can now spawn a maximum of 7 wood & 2 resin when chopped


Weapon balance changes
Semi-automatic, Submachine gun and chainsaw are the most popular weapons with 85% of all kills made by these 3 weapons. With this update, we wanted to tune down these a bit and make other 
weapons more serious options.


Semi-automatic

Semi-auto has been the most popular weapon by a long shot due to its easy acquisition compared to other weapons and its constant damage output. We wanted to emphasize its role as Marskman weapon with the following changes:
Increased the damage from 9 → 12
Reduced fire rate by 33%

Chainsaw

While we want to keep the relevance of a melee weapon in the game we thought that chainsaw was a bit too good. We wanted to lower movement speed to prevent chasing but changed the fire rate/damage ratio to keep it more constant
Lowered movement speed while “firing” by 10%
Increased fire rate by 100%
Decreased damage from 16 → 7

Submachine gun

The submachine gun was also trendy and the global average kill distance was so short that it seems obvious why submachine gun and chainsaw both dominated the place for most used weapon. We wanted to keep its relevancy as the top close combat weapon but we felt like its 1,5-second TTK was too little to allow an opponent to react when shot
Reduced fire rate by 25%



Some other weapons were really lacking in damage or fire rate department and we wanted to raise some weapons stats to be better at their intended role

Crossbow

Crossbow was when introduced intended to be an easy to acquire hunting and combat tool. The current damage was just not cutting it in combat or when hunting and we wanted to give it a serious damage buff to make it shine. Although it will still be a bit lacking with projectile speed and reload speed this should give it more roles as a finisher or when playing in a group and bursting down enemies
Increased damage from 10 → 30

Shotgun

The shotgun is also another early-game weapon really just lacks damage and we wanted to give a little damage boost to make it more in line with other weapons and allow you to do more than just hunting with it
Increased pellet damage from 3.33 → 4 (Note that the shotgun shoots 6 pellets so total single-shot damage is now 20)

Auto shotgun

Automatic shotgun was always meant to be really deadly in close to mid-range but it really did not live up to its intended purpose. Here are the changes we are making to the weapon in order to make it compete with submachine gun as the ultimate close combat weapon that uses more ammo and is not as versatile
Increased pellet damage from 2.5 → 3.5(This shotgun has also 6 pellets per shot)
Increased the ammo consumption/shot from 6 to 12

To make it more punishing to miss your shot and to make this a premium option

Damage fall of increased by 400%

This ensures the intended role as a close combat weapon

Increased fire rate by 50%

Makes the time to kill in line with the submachine gun

notes.title: Recap of last update and removal of discord support ticket system
notes.notes:
Laggy servers

The last update introduced unexpected lag and many problems to those who had updated their house interior. We tried to fix the object pop stutters and memory leaks by cooking the peaceable class so that it was faster to load in memory but took more space in memory. We thought this was fine because there were only about 100 max placeables on screen simultaneously. But this issue came up when running on the full server where each player used around 50% more memory on a server than previously and the server executable would eat 20 Gb of memory on the fully populated server. And because of this official Korean servers 1-3 lost their house placement data when we closed the servers to update them. We are sorry this happened and we will continue optimizing servers as we move towards bigger maps that require more computing power to run more AI and houses etc.

New way to contact us about longvinter
As of today, we are moving away from the Discord ticket system. Discord will still be used as a place to talk about the game, get help from the community and report bugs and meet new people. Press, Business, Hacker, abusive player and technical support reports will be done by filling the form in contact.uuvana.com and communicating by email.

notes.title: PVE Servers + Performance Update
notes.notes:
Hey there,

we're still fixing problems that were found on launch and will soon start adding more content in! We originally planned to add the PVE server option later on the first content update, but it's quite clear that there are a lot of players that want just PVE so there you go!

If you want to make your server PVE only, add this to your Game.ini:

[/Game/Blueprints/Server/GM_Longvinter.GM_Longvinter_C]
PVP=false

Here's a list of some of the changes we've made:
- Made massive improvement on network tick rate for chests and houses. This helps populated servers to run more smoothly 
- Player-placed Turrets can now only be placed near houses. They will not work when placed near your own tent, needs to be upgraded first 
- Turrets that are not near a house will not shoot people anymore 
- Made player placed turrets shoot radius 38% smaller 
- Turrets now have the same behavior as the team gate. They will not shoot players that have entered the house that the turrets are attached to. 
- Previously, only saved placed growing plants but not plants that had fully grown up. This meant basically no saved plants 
- Added height limitation to placed items (goodbye space race) 
- Disabled item duplication glitch that happens when clicking crafting result too fast 
- Fixed a bug where turret could not be placed near your own house due to the adjacent tent or house 
- Lowered farming hat drop rate bonus 10%, from 40 -> 30 - Made game loads more reliable by spreading out loads more 
- Added PVP config variable to servers. PVP is on by default, but the server owner can turn it off if they want to
- Haddock should be easier to find
- Some bug fixes

Thank you to everyone who reported issues on our Discord and Github!

Teo & Nilsson
